verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway provides latency-tracking metrics, semantic caching, load balancing, and streaming support (docs-3, docs-9, docs-11, docs-16, docs-17, docs-24), and its hybrid architecture keeps the control plane out of the data path (docs-50), all of which are consistent with a low-overhead design. However, there is no explicit benchmark, latency-overhead figure, or independent performance test showing the gateway itself adds minimal latency—only that it measures/logs latency after the fact. Missing for 10: quantitative overhead benchmarks, third-party performance testing, and explicit vendor claims of 'low added latency' vs raw provider calls.
